QuestInfo.name: [Eluna Express] Triumph over Adversity
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Eremos about the next step in your training.
QuestInfo.1: In the Dead Mine of El Nath Mountains, there's a place with abnormally strong monsters lurking deep in the heat of the lava. Hunt them and return.
QuestInfo.2: Defeating the monsters in the Cave of Trial was no easy task, but it was well worth the improvement to your skills and training.
